note: Four rules that sat where no test could reach them, moved where one can (register decisions 273, 276 and 385-390). Judged two ways: the three that need no file system -- the exit-code order in app/ExitCodes.hpp and the two device rules in render/VulkanContext.cpp -- by the static_asserts beside them, which stop the build of orbsim, so a kill names the assertion; and write-then-rename by test_file_replace, on a temporary folder, never through --accept-golden (decision 233). **The limit, stated in advance**: these kill a broken rule, not a call to the rule that is removed. The four mutants that remove the calls stay declared survivors in m1-14.json and m1-17.json, re-worded, so the blind spot that remains is written where a machine reads it (decision 276). No survivor is declared here.

mutants.name: a golden mismatch outranks a validation error, in the rule
replaceFile removes the partial file instead of renaming it over the target
the HDR format rule never reports a lack
the colour-space rule accepts any colour space
